key_idea: Give every child a place number counted from the front.
steps: There are 11 children. Pia is number 4 from the front.
Leo is 3rd from the back. Count back from 11: 11, 10, 9. So Leo is number 9 from the front.
The children between them are numbers 5, 6, 7 and 8.

choice_feedback.A: You missed some. Numbers 5, 6, 7 and 8 are all between Pia and Leo.
choice_feedback.B: You missed one. Numbers 5, 6, 7 and 8 are all between Pia and Leo.
choice_feedback.D: You counted Pia or Leo too. Only count the children between them.
choice_feedback.E: You counted Pia and Leo too. Only count the children between them.
